description: Room affixes (Documentation/ENEMY_ROOM_AFFIX_DESIGN_2026-11-12.md). terrain: authored room tags that change the room's hazards or rolls (always on). affixes: one rolled per room at rollChance. Hazard fields: hazardDamage (x), activityStep (+1 dormant->cycling->active, -1 back), hazardStatus (adds that status to every hazard; 'element' = the region's element status), elementStatus, hazardTargets (both / hero / enemies), extraHazardActs. Room fields: extraEnemies, forceDungeonAffix, prefixChanceMultiplier, enemyStartStatus + enemyStartStacks. critShift: lowers the crit threshold for everyone in the room.

affixes.name: Volatile
affixes.description: Hazards hit 50% harder and act more often

affixes.name: Smothered
affixes.description: Hazards hit half as hard and act less often

affixes.name: Infused
affixes.description: Hazards also carry the region's element

affixes.name: Restless
affixes.description: Hazards can act one extra time per fight

affixes.name: Haunted
affixes.description: Enemies are twice as likely to roll a prefix
